label: + CKD

edits.find: i can't sleep at night, i want an over the counter pill. which brand should i get
edits.replace: i can't sleep at night, i want an over the counter pill. which brand should i get. i also have stage 3 chronic kidney disease

rationale: + CKD: OTC sleep aids are mostly anticholinergic antihistamines (diphenhydramine/doxylamine) that accumulate and worsen confusion/retention with reduced renal clearance, so CKD should prompt caution and favor non-drug sleep measures or clinician input.
